problem_text:
A regional sales representative must schedule a series of in-person meetings across five different corporate branch offices.

The travel times between offices are as follows:
* Office Alpha to Beta: 58.7 minutes
* Office Alpha to Gamma: 43.4 minutes
* Office Alpha to Delta: 34.1 minutes
* Office Alpha to Epsilon: 72.5 minutes
* Office Beta to Gamma: 54.0 minutes
* Office Beta to Delta: 25.2 minutes
* Office Beta to Epsilon: 109.5 minutes
* Office Gamma to Delta: 36.7 minutes
* Office Gamma to Epsilon: 56.3 minutes
* Office Delta to Epsilon: 88.1 minutes

The objective is to determine the most time-efficient visitation sequence that allows the representative to conduct a meeting at each branch precisely once before concluding the circuit by returning to the initial office.
